Rooms.Name: A Dimly Lit Path
Rooms.Description:
This path is narrow, REAL narrow.  You draw the conclusion that it
wasn't man-made, or made for man for that matter.  The path continues
north to a village.

Exits.Description: The path continues toward a village.

Rooms.Name: A Dimly Lit Path
Rooms.Description:
This section of the road is badly worn and frequently traversed.
There is some noise coming from the north.  The road back to the forest
lies to the south.

Exits.Description: The path continues toward the village.
The dimly lit path continues south.

Rooms.Name: A Dimly Lit Path
Rooms.Description:
This section of the road is badly worn and frequently traversed.  The
noise is getting stronger to the north.  The road back to the forest
lies to the south.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to Hobbit Village.
You see a dimly lit path.

Rooms.Name: The Entrance to Hobbit Village
Rooms.Description:
You stand at the entrance to a small hobbit village.  You have heard
stories about these little creatures, but you had no idea they really
existed.  You wonder how many people have seen this village before, and
returned to tell about it.  Now go on... explore.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.
You see a dimly lit path.

Rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
Rooms.Description:
A small narrow road here twists through the village.  Hobbit Road
continues to the north, west, and east.  There is still time to turn
back and head south.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road stretches to the north.
Hobbit Road winds of to the east.
You can make out the entrance to Hobbit Village.
Hobbit Road veers off  to the west.

Rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
Rooms.Description:
You continue to stroll down Hobbit Road.  The smell of richly scented
smoke assails your senses as you pass house after immaculate house.
This place is not that bad when you think of it, clean, friendly, and
comfortable.  Perhaps that is why nobody ever seems to leave here...
Hobbit Road continues its path to the north, west, and south.   A small
hobbit home lies to the east.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the north.
Hobbit Road continues to the east.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.
Hobbit Road continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
Rooms.Description:
You stroll along down Hobbit Road.  It continues north and south
here.  To the west you can see a small hobbit home.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the north.
You see the tobacco garden.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.
You see a Hobbit Home.

Rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
Rooms.Description:
The straightforward little Hobbit Road continues in its leisurely
north-south direction. A tobacco garden is to the east.  A stone path
leads west.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the north.
You see the tobacco garden.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.
A stone path lies to the west.

Rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
Rooms.Description:
A small hospitable well sits neatly by the side of the road, waiting
for you to bring up a bucket of fresh cold well water.  A small garden
is to the east. Hobbit Road continues to the south and west, and a road
leads north towards some purple mountains.  The hobbits have had many
adventures with the dwarves and gnomes who live in the highlands north
of here.

Exits.Description:
A long cart track headed north carries produce from the farms north of
here and marvelous weapons from the steel mill.
You see the tobacco garden.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.
Hobbit Road continues to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small well is here.  Just the right size if you're a hobbit, but just
barely big enough for you to get some water from.  I'm sure no-one would
mind.

Rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
Rooms.Description:
A corner of Hobbit Road is where you stand.  A high fence blocks
passage to the east or south.  A hobbit home is to the north.  Hobbit
Road goes back to the west.

Exits.Description: You see a Hobbit Home.
Hobbit Road continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend of Hobbit Road.  You can continue down the road to
the east and north.  You can also visit a hobbit home to the south.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the north.
Hobbit Road continues to the east.
You see a Hobbit Home.

Rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
Rooms.Description:
You are on Hobbit Road.  A hobbit home is to the west.  Took's
backyard is to the north, but you can't go there.  Hobbit Road continues
to the south and east.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the east.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.
You see a Hobbit Home.

Rooms.Name: Stone Path
Rooms.Description:
You are walking along a cute little stone path.  To the south lies
Tooks house.  A small house is to the west.  Hobbit Road is to the
east.  Everything is so peaceful here.  You could stay forever.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the east.
You see Tooks House.
You see a Hobbit House.

Rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
Rooms.Description:
Yet another part of Hobbit Road.  To the west is the last section of
Hobbit Road.  You can go back to the small well to the east.

Exits.Description: Hobbit Road continues to the east.
Hobbit Road continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: Hobbit Road
Rooms.Description:
The last part of Hobbit Road.  You can go back the Hobbit Road to the
east.  A nice, beautiful, hobbit home is to the south.  In the distance
to the north you can see the Hobbit Mayor's office.

Exits.Description: You see the path to Mayor's office.
Hobbit Road continues to the east.
You see a Hobbit Home.

Rooms.Name: The Tobacco Garden
Rooms.Description:
The greatest tobacco in the world is growing here.  If only you were
a smoker... Hobbit Road is back to the west.  Another part of the garden
is to the north.

Exits.Description: The tobacco garden continues to the north.
Hobbit Road continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Tobacco Garden
Rooms.Description:
Another part of the garden.  Small tobacco-leafs is growing here.
The smell is driving your nostrils crazy.  It almost makes you forget
that you don't smoke.  Hobbit Road is to the west, while the garden are
to the north and south.

Exits.Description: The tobacco garden continues to the north.
The tobacco garden continues to the south.
You see Hobbit Road.

Rooms.Name: Tobacco Garden
Rooms.Description:
The northern part of the tobacco garden.  It smells just as good as
all the rest. Hobbit Road is to the west.  The tobacco garden lies to
the south.

Exits.Description: The tobacco garden continues to the south.
You see Hobbit Road.

Rooms.Name: Bilbo's Home
Rooms.Description:
This is the home of the famous Bilbo.  You see a desk all covered
with books, but you can't understand a word in them!  Maybe it is
written in Hobbitish.  Hobbit Road is back to the south.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

Rooms.Name: Frodo's Home
Rooms.Description:
This home looks nice and cozy.  A small sofa is standing in a corner
and the room is covered in papers and books.  Frodo must be a hobbit who
likes to read.  Hobbit Road is back to the west.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

Rooms.Name: Merry's Hole
Rooms.Description:
This home belongs to Merry.  A hobbit who has shared many adventures
with Frodo.  He is a tough hobbit and if he can carry the sword that is
nailed to the wall, he must be quite strong.  Better not make him angry
with you!  Hobbit Road is back to the north.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

Rooms.Name: Sam's Home
Rooms.Description:
The home of Sam and Rosa.  The house is all clean and shiny.  Rosa
and Sam must like to have things clean in case they have visitors.
Maybe you should stay a while.  This place is nice.  Hobbit Road to the
east.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

Rooms.Name: Pippin's Home
Rooms.Description:
The home of Pippin.  A tough hobbit who has been on many adventures.
You have heard rumors about this guy.  People say he is a mean and
strong hobbit, just like his cousin Merry.  Maybe you should leave
before he find you here.  Hobbit Road to the east may be your only
salvation.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

Rooms.Name: Bogo's Hole
Rooms.Description:
Bogo, the laughing stock of the hobbit village lives here.  This
place is all dirty and dusty.  Maybe Bogo is here somewhere, but you are
not sure.  Anyway, you don't really like the smell of this place.
Hobbit Road is to the north.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

Rooms.Name: Took's House
Rooms.Description:
Took's home.  The home of Took.  You have heard stories about this
guy.  The other hobbits say he is big and strong and some people say he
knows his way around magic.  You can see a desk here, all covered with
papers.  There seems to be some magic words written on the papers, but
you can't understand them.  A stone  path lies to the north.

Exits.Description: You see a stone path.

Rooms.Name: Path to Hobbit Mayor's Office
Rooms.Description:
You are walking along a path to the Mayor's office to the North.
Hobbit Road lies to the south.

Exits.Description: Outside the Hobbit Mayor's office.
Hobbit Road continues to the south.

Rooms.Name: Outside the Hobbit Mayor's Office
Rooms.Description:
You are standing outside the Mayor's office.  You can hear him
screaming at his employees inside from the road.  His office is to the
north, while Hobbit Road is to the south.

Exits.Description: You see the Hobbit Mayor's office.
You see the path to Hobbit Mayor's office.

Rooms.Name: The Hobbit Mayor's Office
Rooms.Description:
This is the office of the Hobbit Mayor.  You can see a huge desk
where he usually sits and look busy.  The office is quite large with
nice paintings on the walls.  The desk is all covered with papers.

Exits.Description: Outside the Hobbit Mayor's office.

Rooms.Name: Rosa's Home
Rooms.Description:
This is Rosa's home still, since she and Sam aren't legally wedded
yet. However if she is not here, she is most likely at Sam's.  The only
exit is to the east.

Exits.Description: You see Hobbit Road.

Mobs.Name: hobbit
Mobs.LongDescription: A hobbit is strolling around here.
Mobs.Description: A short, fat hobbit is strolling along here, talking to himself.

Mobs.Name: hobbit
Mobs.LongDescription: A fat hobbit is here, gathering tobacco.
Mobs.Description: A short fat hobbit is here, gathering tobacco. He seems to like his work.

Mobs.Name: bilbo hobbit
Mobs.Description: Bilbo stands here, daydreaming about long gone adventures.

Mobs.Name: frodo hobbit
Mobs.LongDescription: Frodo is standing here, smoking his pipe.
Mobs.Description: Frodo seems to be a nice hobbit with his big belly and hairy feet.

Mobs.Name: sam hobbit
Mobs.LongDescription: Sam, Frodo's gardener is here mowing the lawn.
Mobs.Description:
Sam seems to be a kind hobbit. He is short and fat and shouldn't be that hard
to squash.

Mobs.Name: merry hobbit
Mobs.LongDescription: Merry is standing here, looking almost as mean as his cousin Pippin.
Mobs.Description:
Merry is standing here. He's a tall and muscular hobbit and he DOES look mean.
If you are going to fight a hobbit, don't fight this guy.

Mobs.Name: pippin hobbit
Mobs.LongDescription: Pippin is standing here, looking almost as mean as his cousin Merry.
Mobs.Description:
Pippin is a tall muscular hobbit who just LOVES to fight. Challange him if you
want to but I wouldn't reccomend it.

Mobs.Name: bogo hobbit
Mobs.LongDescription: Bogo is standing here with a bottle to his mouth as usual.
Mobs.Description:
Bogo the hobbit drunk is here, drinking as usual. He doesn't look too tough. 
Maybe you should put an end to his misery.

Mobs.Name: rosa female hobbit
Mobs.LongDescription: Rosa is here, looking for her beloved Sam.
Mobs.Description: Rosa, Sam's wife-to-be is standing here, wondering where Sam is.

Mobs.Name: took hobbit
Mobs.LongDescription: Took is standing here, mumbling some magic words.
Mobs.Description:
Took, an old experienced hobbit is standing here. This hobbit saw adventures 
before you were even born. Some hobbits say he knows his way around magic but
of course, that is just rumours.

Mobs.Name: mayor hobbit
Mobs.LongDescription: The hobbit mayor is here, looking busy.
Mobs.Description:
The mayor of the hobbits is here, trying hard to look busy. He is a tough built
hobbit, although he seems to be kind. He controls the hobbit village with a
firm but fair hand.

Mobs.Name: karo dog
Mobs.LongDescription: Karo, the mayor's loyal watchdog is here.
Mobs.Description:
Karo, the hobbit mayor's loyal watchdog is here, looking confused. This dog
appears to have a problem with both his IQ and his weight. However, he is big
and you have the feeling that he bites hard.

Objects.Name: leaf tobacco
Objects.Description: A small but nice-smelling tobacco leaf is lying here.

Objects.Name: monocle
Objects.Description: A small monocle is lying on the ground here.

Objects.Name: black hat
Objects.Description: A small black hat has been left here.

Objects.Name: tiny axe
Objects.Description: A tiny axe has been left here.

Objects.Name: medallion
Objects.Description: A small medallion is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: pink potion
Objects.Description: A pink potion is barely visible on the ground.

Objects.Name: small red wand
Objects.Description: A small red wand have been left here.

Objects.Name: key
Objects.Description: A tiny key is lying here. You hardly notice it.

Objects.Name: water well
Objects.Description: A small hobbit well is here.

Objects.Name: key
Objects.Description: A key to hobbit mayor's office lies here.
